title: Coefficient and site squares for the explicit refinement theta
statement:
Let $X,T_1,T_2$ be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme], meaning schemes admitting finite affine covers by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $u:T_1\to T_2$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $j_a:X\hookrightarrow T_a$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] with $uj_1=j_2$. Use the constant-ring module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For every finite commutative ring $R$, form $V=T_1\times_{T_2}X$ with $b:V\to T_1$, $p:V\to X$, and the open-and-closed section $s=(j_1,1_X):X\to V$. Let
$$\theta_{u,R}=c_{p,s,R}\circ Rp_{*,R}(e_{u,R})\circ r_{u,R}:j_2^*Ru_{*,R}j_{1!}\xrightarrow{\sim}1$$
be the specified composite of open restriction $r_u$, open base-change $e_u:b^*j_{1!}\cong s_!$, and component restriction $c_{p,s}:Rp_*s_!\cong1$ in [def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison, lem-weil-pbc-derived-open-restriction, lem-weil-pbc-clopen-section-direct-image]. Let $\alpha_{u,R}:j_{2!}\to Ru_{*,R}j_{1!}$ be the open adjunct of $\theta_{u,R}^{-1}$ specified there.

Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings and set $T_T=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let $t_a:T a_{!,A}\cong a_{!,B}T$ be the summandwise open tensor map, and $q_u:T Ru_{*,A}\to Ru_{*,B}T$ the $B$-linear adjoint transpose of the $A$-counit after coefficient extension, using the canonical pullback/tensor comparison. For every $L\in D^+(X_{\rm et},A)$ with $L_B\in D^+(X_{\rm et},B)$,
$$Ru_{*,B}(t_{j_1}(L))\circ q_u(j_{1!,A}L)\circ T_{T_2}(\alpha_{u,A}(L))
=\alpha_{u,B}(L_B)\circ t_{j_2}(L).$$
This is an equality in the unbounded category, without asserting $T(D^+)\subseteq D^+$.

For a finite commutative $R$ write $N_T=\nu_T^*$, $e_j:N j_!^{\rm et}\cong j_!^{\rm pro}N$ for the canonical open comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], and $d_u:N Ru_*^{\rm et}\cong Ru_*^{\rm pro}N$ for the counit mate [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. Define $\theta_{u,R}^{\rm pro}$ on etale-origin bounded-below input by the same three constituents: the site-transported open-restriction exchange, the summandwise open base-change identification, and restriction to the clopen component. Let $\alpha_{u,R}^{\rm pro}$ be the open adjunct of its inverse. Then for every $L\in D^+(X_{\rm et},R)$,
$$Ru_{*,R}^{\rm pro}(e_{j_1}(L))\circ d_u(j_{1!}^{\rm et}L)\circ N_{T_2}(\alpha_{u,R}(L))
=\alpha_{u,R}^{\rm pro}(N_XL)\circ e_{j_2}(L).$$
Both equations are natural in $L$ and require no cartesian hypothesis on the original refinement square and no flatness hypothesis on $B$ over $A$.

source.place: Tag 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open), specialized to a refinement, with the theta_u construction specified in def-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison. Agent-stated naturality of the three constituents under coefficient and site change.

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.properOpenComparison_coefficient_refinement from [lem-sf-proper-open-coefficient-refinement] with the given coefficient map, proper map, open immersions, refinement equation, bounded-below complex and its scalar-extension bound. Its conclusion is definitionally the first conjunct, with exactly the same normalized coefficient and proper/open arrows.

Fix the finite ring R and bounded-below complex K. Expand properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus of [lem-weil-pbc-proper-open-comparison-proetale]. Its hom is the inverse open-site comparison at j2, followed by comparison pullback of the etale proper/open arrow, the canonical direct-image mate, and direct image of the open-site comparison at j1. Compose on the left with the open-site comparison at j2. CategoryTheory.Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc cancels it with its inverse. The remaining three factors are exactly the right side of the second conjunct. Pair this equality, universally quantified over R and K, with the first conjunct.

lean.statement: theorem refinementCoefficientMate {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B) {X T₁ T₂ : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian T₁] [IsNoetherian T₂] (u : T₁ ⟶ T₂) [IsProper u] (j₁ : X ⟶ T₁) (j₂ : X ⟶ T₂) [IsOpenImmersion j₁] [IsOpenImmersion j₂] (h : j₁ ≫ u = j₂) (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (hL : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus ((Etale.scalarExtension φ X).obj L.obj)) : (Etale.scalarExtension φ T₂).map (Etale.properOpenComparisonAmbient A u j₁ j₂ h L) ≫ (Etale.scalarMate φ u).app ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j₁).mapDerivedCategory.obj L.obj) ≫ (Etale.rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) u).map (Etale.properOpenCoefficientOpenIso φ j₁ L.obj).hom = (Etale.properOpenCoefficientOpenIso φ j₂ L.obj).hom ≫ Etale.properOpenComparisonAmbient B u j₁ j₂ h { obj := (Etale.scalarExtension φ X).obj L.obj, property := hL } ∧ (∀ {R : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [Finite R] (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))), (ProEtale.properOpenSiteExtensionIso R j₂).hom.app K ≫ (ProEtale.properOpenProEtaleIsoPlus R u j₁ j₂ h K).hom = (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) T₂).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (Etale.properOpenComparison R u j₁ j₂ h K) ≫ (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange (ProEtale.lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange u (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R))).app ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) j₁).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫ (ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) u).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map ((ProEtale.properOpenSiteExtensionIso R j₁).hom.app K))
